name: Ashmaw’s Mantle
text: A strip of ash-grey hide, offered for the shoulders that stood their ground. +4 maximum HP; resistance to fire.

name: Bat-Bone Flute
text: A clean, hollow note that carries through stone. +2 initiative; +1 Charisma saving throws.

name: Hearthstone Pendant
text: A smooth stone from the cold edge of the lair. Advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

name: Ashwood Totem
text: A carved sprig from timber that endured the heat. Resistance to fire; +1 movement.

name: Ember-Claw Gauntlet
text: A small claw set into a watchman’s leather wrist-guard. +1 to attack rolls.

name: Cinder Wraps
text: Soft ash-dyed bands, wound with the patience of a long watch. +1 AC.

name: Warden’s Ember Badge
text: An old watch badge polished for one more promise. +1 Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

name: Ashmaw-Tooth Arrowheads
text: Carefully shaped points from the beast’s broken teeth. +1 damage.

name: Kobold Delver’s Ring
text: A plain brass ring worn smooth against a pick handle. +2 initiative; +1 Dexterity saving throws.

name: Smouldering Eye
text: A polished amber-glass charm, not an ember shard. +1 Constitution saving throws; begin each battle with 3 temporary HP.

name: Ash-Black Sigil
text: A ward scratched into soot-dark iron. +1 Wisdom saving throws; resistance to necrotic damage.

name: Kobold Surveyor’s Lens
text: A scratched lens that still measures a true line. +1 Intelligence saving throws; +1 initiative.
